prompt: Static locked-off camera, the framing never changes. The kneeling man stays completely still: his two open palms stay apart and facing upward exactly as they are, his head does not turn. The only movement: palm fronds sway softly in a light breeze, the pool ripples gently, the wildflowers in the foreground sway, white clouds drift slowly. Peaceful, bright daylight.
